Five offline modes. One more personal best.

Swap neighboring blocks, make matches and unleash your powers at the right moment. Popzuno offers five ways to chase your next personal best.

Ascend · Rush · Time Rush · Daily 90 · Relax

Survive a rising board in Rush. Earn more seconds by matching in Time Rush. Complete stage goals in Ascend. Take on the same UTC-day opening in Daily 90. Relax: no timer or rising rows; the board refills after moves. Play at your pace with calm music.

Your faces, your game

Play immediately with illustrated faces, or personalize seven characters with photos you have permission to use. Photos are processed on your device. No account, ads, analytics or in-app purchases. One paid download, offline play. Records stay local; Daily is not an online leaderboard.
